items.title: OpenClaw 0-Click Vulnerability Allows Malicious Websites to Hijack Developer AI Agents
items.description: A critical zero-interaction vulnerability in OpenClaw, one of the fastest-growing open-source AI agent frameworks in history, has been discovered by Oasis Security researchers, allowing any malicious website to silently seize full control of a developer’s AI agent without requiring plugins, extensions, or any user action. items.title: Flaw-Finding AI Assistants Face Criticism for Speed, Accuracy
items.description: Using AI to find security vulnerabilities holds significant promise, but the initial products fall short of the needs of enterprises and software developers, say experts.
